summary: Backend-only P0 review (3 user-reported bugs). 11 pytest cases against /api/picks/today, /api/picks/parlay, and direct Mongo audit. RESULTS: 9 PASSED, 2 FAILED. BUG #1 GRADE CONSISTENCY: STILL BROKEN intermittently. At test time the DB held 20 picks with lock_score>=85 AND grade='Pass' (Soccer 15, MLB 5; full list logged), and /api/picks/today returned 55/115 (48%) wrong-Pass picks. Manually re-running validate_and_heal() cleared all 20 → 0, proving the validator IS the fix path. The fix to learning_system_v2.apply_v2_to_picks step 4 + step 5 (re-apply bet-quality floor, then re-grade) ONLY runs at fresh pick generation. The soccer pipeline (every 15 min) upserts via $set on existing picks with non-spec grade vocabulary ('A+','B+','ELITE' from _grade_from_conf) and stale lock_scores; the validator (also 30-min loop) eventually reconciles, but between cycles the user sees broken grades. BUG #2 SORT TOGGLE: FULLY FIXED. lock-desc top: [98.0,97.9,97.9,97.4,97.2], lock-asc top: [85.0,85.1,85.4,85.8,86.7], edge-desc top: [46.0,46.0,22.16,20.56,15.96], edge-asc top: [2.16,2.37,2.39,2.47,2.6], time-asc, win-desc all monotonic; desc vs asc top-10 IDs differ. BUG #3 HIGH-RISK PARLAY 72h: FULLY FIXED. /api/picks/parlay?legs=10&mode=high_risk&window_hours=72 returns parlays=[9-leg, 9-leg, 9-leg] survival 16.1/16.0/15.8%. BUG #4 AUTO-EXPAND 24h: Logic correct (server.py:1340-1373) but not exercised — 24h call returned 3 parlays directly with auto_expanded_to=None (24h already had enough picks). The auto-expand code path is reachable but un-tested on today's slate. lock_score overflow >99: 0 picks (clamp at sports_engine:341 + learning_system_v2:569 holds).

critical.issue: Persistent drift: DB held 20 picks with lock_score>=85 AND grade='Pass' (Soccer 15 + MLB 5; samples lock=91.3/91.6/96.8/95.9/94.7/93.9), API returned 55/115 (48%) wrong-Pass. Root cause: the learning_system_v2 floor+regrade fix (steps 4&5) ONLY fires at FRESH pick generation in _refresh_picks. The soccer pipeline upserts via $set every 15 min using to_picks_collection_doc/make_over_1_5_pick which write non-spec grades ('A+','B+','ELITE','A','B','C' from _grade_from_conf at soccer/predictor.py:239-245). The validator (loop every 30 min) reconciles via _grade(), but between cycles the user sees broken grades because (a) soccer upserts overwrite grade with the wrong vocabulary, (b) the validator step 4 tolerance of 6.0 means edge-driven lock shifts under 6pts don't trigger lock-rewrite or grade-re-sync, leaving stale lock+grade pairs. Manually invoking validate_and_heal() now cleared all 20 → 0. Permanent fixes: (i) replace _grade_from_conf at soccer/predictor.py:239-245 with the unified sports_engine._grade(lock) so soccer upserts write the same vocabulary, (ii) move apply_v2_to_picks (or at least step 5 re-grade) into the soccer pipeline AFTER upsert, OR (iii) make pick_validator step 5 the sole authority and reduce its loop interval from 30 min → 5 min.

minor.issue: Auto-expand fallback at server.py:1340-1373 is correct but not exercised today — 24h pool was already deep enough (3 parlays returned, auto_expanded_to=None). Cannot confirm the 72/168 escalation works end-to-end until a thin-slate day or a test that artificially restricts the candidate pool. Suggest a unit test that mocks db.picks.find to return 0 docs in the 24h band and asserts auto_expanded_to=72 or 168 in the response.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/soccer/predictor.py:239-245 — `_grade_from_conf` returns 'ELITE'/'A+'/'A'/'B+'/'B'/'C' which is INCONSISTENT with the user-spec vocabulary the rest of the app uses ('Elite Lock'/'Strong Lock'/'Lock'/'Playable'/'Pass'). Every soccer-pipeline upsert writes the wrong vocabulary, which the validator then has to reconcile. This is the proximate cause of the persistent grade-mismatch bug.

/app/backend/pick_validator.py:164 — tolerance of 6.0 means edge-driven lock shifts <6pts skip the lock-rewrite branch AND the grade-re-sync branch nested inside it. The unconditional step 5 (line 197-212) is the only safety net, and it relies on `_grade(lock)` matching the stored grade, which it always will after step 4 (no-op when within tolerance). The user-visible bug is purely intermediate-state during the 15-min window between soccer upserts and the next validator cycle.

/app/backend/sports_engine.py:171-183 — `_grade` thresholds are correct (>=98 Elite Lock, >=95 Strong Lock, >=90 Lock, >=85 Playable, <85 Pass). The 99-clamp at line 341 and the duplicate clamp at learning_system_v2.py:569 both hold (0 overflow detected in 281 picks).

/app/backend/server.py:1340-1373 — high_risk auto-expand logic is correct (24h→72h→168h fallback), but the no-parlay reason string at server.py:1387-1391 still hardcodes 'Lock>=88, Edge>=+3%, positive ROI' for all modes (was flagged in iter_15 and not addressed).

/app/backend/learning_system_v2.py:557-572 — the bet-quality floor re-application after market_weight + calibration demotion is correctly placed and effective on the picks that pass through `apply_v2_to_picks`. The fix is good. Problem is the function isn't called on the upsert path.

rca_of_issue:
RCA Bug #1 (Pass label on Lock 97 etc): The fix described in the brief (learning_system_v2.apply_v2_to_picks step 4 floor + step 5 re-grade) is correctly implemented and works AT PICK GENERATION TIME. However, the picks DB is mutated by THREE other paths that bypass that pipeline:
  (1) /app/backend/soccer/pipeline.py:148 upserts soccer picks every 15 min using to_picks_collection_doc(pred) which writes grade=_grade_from_conf(conf) — a non-spec vocabulary ('A+', 'ELITE', 'B+', etc.) NOT matching ('Elite Lock','Strong Lock','Lock','Playable','Pass'). When the validator's step 5 next runs and reads grade='A+', it cannot map to any spec grade, so it overwrites with _grade(lock). But if soccer pipeline upserts AGAIN before validator finishes, the cycle repeats.
  (2) The validator step 4 (tolerance 6.0) skips lock-rewrite for picks where edge changed <6pts. If a pick's lock_score was previously demoted to e.g. 84 via apply_v2 calibration demotion at generation (grade='Pass'), then a later edge bump raises lock to 91 BUT step 4 may skip the rewrite if the delta is under 6pts — leaving lock=91 grade='Pass' (or lock=85 grade='Pass' as in the 'bf27165f' sample).
  (3) Step 5's unconditional re-grade DOES fix this, but only on the next 30-min cycle. The intermediate-state visibility window is up to 30 min wide. User reports of 'Lock 97 says Pass' fall into this window.
Reproduction: at T=now, query db.picks.find({lock_score:{$gte:85}, grade:'Pass', pick_date:today}) → count ≥ 0 depending on cycle phase. Sampling at T+5min shows different picks in the bad set. Mitigation: (a) replace _grade_from_conf with sports_engine._grade in soccer/predictor.py, OR (b) call apply_v2_to_picks (or at minimum a step-5 re-grade) inside soccer/pipeline.py before each upsert batch.
RCA Bug #2 (Sort toggle): NOT BROKEN. server.py:930-977 correctly applies the sort and direction params. Test confirmed lock/edge/time/win all sort correctly, and lock-desc vs lock-asc return different top-10 IDs. The previous user report may have been a frontend caching issue.
RCA Bug #3 (High-risk parlay 72h empty): NOT REPRODUCING. 72h window returns 3 cards with 9 legs each. The auto-expand logic added at server.py:1340-1373 plus the frontend onModeChange setting windowHours=72 should fully address the original complaint.
RCA Bug #4 (auto-expand 24h): Code path EXISTS and is structurally correct. Today's slate has enough picks in 24h that the fallback isn't triggered, so auto_expanded_to=None correctly. To verify the fallback fires, future testing needs a thin-slate scenario.
